prompt: Why does this architecture use an intermediate Sm* query model (SmBooleanQuery, SmTermQuery, SmBoostQuery, etc.) instead of building Lucene queries directly? Name two reasons in one short sentence.
notes: Backend-agnostic (reusable for Solr or ES); inspectable/debuggable; composable

prompt: When buildWeightedSmQuery decides whether a tag becomes MUST or SHOULD, what are the two conditions that promote a tag to MUST?
notes: Tag has hasMandatoryField()==true, OR mm equals phraseTokensCount (full phrase match path)

prompt: What is a dependency group in this architecture, and why is it needed? Two short sentences using the example of part attributes.
notes: Some fields (attr_*) are only meaningful with a root field (category); group ensures dependents only fire with root

prompt: A path includes a RECOGNIZED_PRODUCT tag spanning 3 token positions. The total path covers 5 tokens. What value of phraseTokensCount does buildWeightedSmQuery use for mm calculation?
Does the minShouldMatch in stage configs use the same formula syntax as eDisMax mm? One word.
notes: Yes; calculateMinShouldMatch uses same eDisMax mm syntax (e.g., 2<-25%)

prompt: Why does CommonSemanticSearcher run multiple stages sequentially instead of a single one? One sentence.
notes: Strict-first staging: high-precision stage first, fall back to looser if no hits

prompt: When applying this architecture, on which Solr collection does the SemanticSearchHandler register: the concepts collection or the catalog collection? One word.
notes: Catalog (the searchable corpus); concepts is just for tag lookup

prompt: And on which Solr collection does the TagHandler register? One word.
notes: Concepts collection; tagger looks up against the concept dictionary

prompt: Why is it a mistake to index a free-text catalog field like description_text into the concept collection? One short sentence.
notes: Free-text creates high-cardinality noisy entries that match everything and destroy precision

prompt: The BLM (Brand/Line/Model) post-processor validates against a CatalogProvider before recognizing a BLM combination. What does this validation prevent? One sentence.
notes: Prevents recognition of invalid BLM combinations like 'Sony WH-5000XX' that don't exist in the catalog

prompt: If my domain is open-ended natural language (like FAQs or user reviews) and this architecture is a bad fit, what alternative Solr feature should I look at instead? One short answer.
notes: Vector/kNN/dense embedding search; covered in solr-query/07-knn.md

prompt: Name three configurable parameters per stage in StagesConfig that affect query strictness.
notes: minShouldMatch, minPatternScore/minPathScore, resolvers, fields list, cutoff

prompt: I want to visualize the tag graph for a specific user query. Which request parameter to the TagHandler do I add to get a graphviz-compatible output? One word.
notes: dot=true returns DOT format under tagsDot in the response

prompt: How many Solr collections does a full deployment of this architecture typically use, and what are their roles?
notes: Two: a small concepts/dictionary collection + the large catalog collection
